message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -rn "satellites_visible" drivers/*.c | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
I see - `fill_dop` iterates `k < gpsdata->satellites_visible` and accesses `gpsdata->skyview[k]`. The `skyview` array has `MAXCHANNELS` (184) entries. If `satellites_visible` exceeds 184, this would be a global-buffer-overflow READ. The fuzzer comment says `MAX_SATS 184` and mentions clearing satellite data to prevent OOB in fill_dop.

The crash is a "Global-buffer-overflow READ 1" in `gpsd_poll`. Let me look at how `satellites_visible` gets set by the various drivers. Let me look at the drivers that parse satellite data. Let me check the UBX driver since it's a common one, and look at how satellites_visible is set.
